description: Hash-evidence over an artifact whose exact bytes begin with the UTF-8 BOM (0xEF 0xBB 0xBF) and use CRLF line endings. The SHA-256 in the evidence entry is computed over the exact raw bytes on disk; the pipeline verifies the digest against those bytes verbatim, without stripping the BOM or normalizing CRLF to LF. The proposal is low-impact (read) so trust-upgrade semantics do not interfere; the load-bearing assertion is that hash verification treats the artifact bytes as opaque and does not re-encode line endings or strip byte-order marks. Corresponds to HERMETICUM Phase 2 case ADV-005. The artifact is protected from line-ending / text-normalization filters by a narrow .gitattributes rule ('conformance/artifacts/bom_crlf_payload.bin binary').
source: PIC-maintained adaptation of HERMETICUM Phase 2 case ADV-005. Methodology attribution: HERMETICUM B.C.E. S.r.l., Independent Protocol Stress Test methodology, Manuel Coletta, Founder. proposal.intent: Read a document whose bytes contain a BOM and CRLF line endings
